map.「一帆风顺」→ 顺理成章 → 章句之徒；末字「顺」接「顺…」或同音「瞬/舜」；规: yi fan feng shun goes to shun li zhang chang, then to zhang ju zhi tu. The final character shun can take shun... or the homophones shun and shun. The rule can require the same character or the same sound.
map.末字是多音或生僻（如「为」wéi/wèi）易卡壳；可设允许同音放宽，或限定常用成: A final character with multiple readings or a rare one (such as wei, read two ways) easily blocks the chain. Allow homophones to relax it, or restrict the idiom pool to common idioms for smoother play.
map.接龙用末字还是读音？: Does the Chain Use the Final Character or the Sound?
map.常见两种：严格末汉字相同，或只要求同音（含声调）；教学常用同字更练书写。: Two common variants: strictly the same final Chinese character, or only the same sound (tone included). Teaching usually prefers the same character to also drill writing.
map.可允许同音、查成语词典，或换规则（如限定某主题成语）；纯娱乐不必纠结唯一解。: Allow homophones, look up an idiom dictionary, or change the rule (for example limit idioms to a theme). For pure fun there is no need to insist on a unique solution.
